messages.content: You are a careful, fair evaluator.

You are grading a model-generated RAG answer for hallucination. Judge ONE failure mode and ignore style, length, helpfulness, or any other quality.

FAILURE MODE: HALLUCINATION
Definition: the response states a fact (number, date, name, policy, causal claim, attribution) that is NOT supported by the provided source text. Faithful to the source = not hallucinated. Refusal or hedging is not a hallucination.

The source text below is the ONLY thing facts can be grounded in.

--- TASK TYPE ---
Summary

--- SOURCE TEXT ---
Jerusalem (CNN)The Israeli military conducted airstrikes Sunday night in the area between Israel and Syria, targeting a group of militants allegedly trying to plant a bomb on the Israeli border. The Israel Defense Forces said the airstrikes were carried out in the occupied Golan Heights against four militants who crossed into the area from Syria. "A group of armed terrorists approached the border with an explosive device, which was intended to be detonated against IDF forces," the Israeli military said. The airstrikes prevented the bombing, the military said. Three of the alleged attackers were killed, Israeli media reported, citing IDF sources. It was not immediately known to what militant group the men belonged. The Golan is regarded internationally as occupied territory despite Israeli governmental control. It is home to 41,000 residents, including Jews, Druze and Alawites. Israel seized the territory from Syria during the 1967 Israel-Arab war, and it was eventually annexed.


--- RESPONSE TO JUDGE ---
Israeli airstrikes kill 3 militants in Golan Heights, preventing bombing attack.

--- QUESTION (QA task type only; "(n/a)" for Summary) ---
(n/a)

Rules:
1. Consider only the HALLUCINATION mode above; everything else is out of scope.
2. Use the source text above as the ONLY grounding.
3. A fact is a hallucination if the source text does not state or entail it.
4. List every fact you flag in `unsupported_claims`; leave it empty when the verdict is "no".
5. Set `hallucinated` to true if and only if `unsupported_claims` is not empty.

Respond with JSON only:
{{"hallucinated": true, "unsupported_claims": ["<verbatim-ish excerpt of each ungrounded fact>"]}}

schema.description:
Structured LLM-judge reply for the `judge` command.

`hallucinated` is the binary verdict (true = the response states at least
one fact the source does not support).  `unsupported_claims` is the list
of specific facts the judge flagged as ungrounded — empty when the verdict
is a clean "no".

hallucinated.description: True if the response states at least one fact the source does not support.
hallucinated.title: Hallucinated

unsupported_claims.description: The specific facts in the response the source does not support (empty if none).
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

schema.title: HallucJudgeVerdict
